query: SELECT evaluation_metric, performance_on_hotpotqa, performance_on_NQ FROM cspaper WHERE (performance_on_hotpotqa = 'EM (x4 compression): 0.430; EM (x16 compression): 0.426; EM (x128 compression): 0.378' AND uses_knowledge_graph != 'Yes') OR (retrieval_method = 'Hybrid Retrieval; Dense Retrieval' AND evaluation_dataset != 'MMCU-Medical; CMB-Exam; CMB-Clin');
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。
